title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: After a rough game
hook: A player had a rough game. Do you say something?
intro: One player is sitting alone with their head down.
statement: How you handle a bad day stays with a kid.
q1: Do you talk with them right after the game —
q2: or wait until the next practice?
q3: What does that player need to hear?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But players bounce back
t2: when they know one game does not define them.
cta: Coaches — what do you say after a bad game?
ctaLines: A quiet word. A pat on the back. Talk next practice.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player had a rough game. Do you say something?
The game is over. One player is sitting alone with their head down.
How you handle a bad day stays with a kid.
Talk now or talk at the next practice. There is no perfect answer.
What do you say after a bad game? Share your habit in the comments.
